title: Pick a class: Sorcerer
caption: New character now offers the Sorcerer after the Assassin, the Ranger, the Gladiator, the Spiritmaster, the Templar and the Cleric.

title: A Sorcerer at level 22
caption: A Sorcerer character gets its own guide: Flame Arrow first, Element Enhancement for stigma slot 1, each with its game icon.

title: Conditions, loop and Hellfire
caption: The Build plan says which three Sorcerer skills fire only on a condition, gives the leveling loop and says to hold 4 to charge Hellfire.

title: Sorcerer stats and keys
caption: The Build tab shows Attack, Critical Hit and MP first, plus the game's default keys from your Sorcerer screen.
